summary: Comprehensive testing of Astro SSR Anpabelt personal site (unified frontend+backend on port 3000, endpoints under /actions/*, media at /media/*). Ran pytest suite (18/18 pass) + full Playwright UI E2E covering public pages, blog rendering, contact form, admin auth, dashboard, tabs, CRUD, cover/media upload, delete, sitemap and robots. Overall the app is in very good shape. Two functional issues found: (1) After creating a new post via Save Draft, the Delete button does not appear because the editor uses history.replaceState (client-side URL swap) instead of a full navigation, so `initial.id` remains falsy in the server-rendered template; delete is only available after a page reload. (2) The slug generator strips underscores without replacing them with dashes, so titles like `TEST_UI_Post_123` produce slug `testuipost123` instead of `test-ui-post-123` (minor UX issue). Also, HTML5 email validation blocks the invalid-email submit before hitting /actions/contact so the contact-status testid never receives the server error text (server-side validation itself works and returns 400 for invalid email via API).

ui_bugs.issue: editor-delete-button is not rendered right after Save Draft on /admin/posts/new because the code uses history.replaceState instead of a real navigation to /admin/posts/:id/edit. The `{initial.id && ...}` block is server-rendered, so the Delete button only shows up after a full page reload. From a fresh /admin/posts/:id/edit URL, delete works fine.

Slugify strips underscores instead of treating them as separators: `TEST_UI_Post_1789217431` -> `testuipost1789217431`. Recommend replacing `/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g` with a rule that maps `_` (and other separators) to a space/dash first.

The email input uses type="email" with required, so an invalid email like `bad-email` is blocked by the browser's HTML5 validation popup and the request never reaches /actions/contact. Result: [data-testid="contact-status"] stays empty on invalid submissions. Server-side validation still works (returns 400). If the reviewer expects an in-page error via contact-status, add JS-driven validation or use type=text with client-side regex before submit.

action_items: PostEditor: after first save of a new post, either do a real window.location assign to `/admin/posts/:id/edit` (so the server rerenders and shows the Delete button) OR toggle a hidden Delete button client-side once `state.id` is set.
PostEditor slugify: treat `_` (and other non-alnum) as word separators (e.g. `.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')`) so multi-word titles produce readable slugs.

Optional: make Contact form show its own in-page error (via contact-status) on invalid email instead of relying on the browser's native email validation popup, so the QA-visible flow is deterministic.
critical_code_review_comments: PostEditor.astro uses `history.replaceState` after first save which desynchronizes the server-rendered UI (Delete button conditional). Prefer full navigation or client-side conditional rendering.
Slugify regex is too aggressive; underscores and other punctuation get concatenated instead of split. Low-severity but affects readability of URLs.
seed_admin and sqlite path: verified admin login works with credentials from /app/frontend/.env and posts persist in SQLite (/app/frontend/data/blog.db).
Endpoints correctly enforce 401 without cookie for POST /actions/posts and POST /actions/upload; GET /media/:filename is public (200 with image/* content-type).

Sitemap includes /blog URLs; robots.txt (application-served) contains Sitemap line and Disallow /admin (note Cloudflare also injects its own robots response header block but the Astro-served content is correct).

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all critical flows pass; 2 minor issues + 1 contact UX detail)

seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted several TEST_UI_Post_* draft/published posts and a couple of uploaded PNG assets. Any residual uploads in /app/frontend/data/uploads are 1x1 test PNGs; posts were cleaned up via DELETE /actions/posts/:id.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend/API suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_anpabelt_api.py and uses BASE_URL from SITE_URL env or the hardcoded preview URL fallback. Admin auth is a plain JSON POST to /actions/auth/login that sets an httpOnly `admin_session` cookie. Post IDs are nanoid strings (not numeric) — regex should be `/[^/]+` when matching edit URLs. Slug is user-editable in the editor (data-testid=editor-slug-input) and auto-derived from title only until first touch. When testing 'published post visible publicly', prefer reading `post.slug` from the API response instead of guessing from the title.
rca of the issue: 1) Missing Delete button after Save Draft: PostEditor.astro line ~140 uses `window.history.replaceState({}, '', /admin/posts/${post.id}/edit)`. This only updates the URL bar, it does not re-render the Astro template. The Delete button lives inside `{initial.id && (...)}` which is evaluated server-side, so it stays absent until the user reloads. Mitigation: either `window.location.href = ...` after first save, or move the Delete button to always render in the DOM (hidden) and toggle visibility once `state.id` is set. 2) Slug bug: slugify uses `.replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, '')` which drops `_` silently before whitespace splitting, so `TEST_UI_Post` collapses to `testuipost`. Fix by replacing non-alphanumerics with a space/dash first.
